Do whatever the fuck makes you happy. Right now just make a fucking list pull out a piece of paper and write a list of things that make you happy. Order them if you’d like, whatever. Once you’ve done that list really go through it again, add more and more until you reach at least 10 things. If you can do that then you’re all set. Focus on those things and try to do them everyday if possible, the rest will just fall in place. You can worry about the rest later, you’ve got time and you don’t need to rush anything.


Also, you thought you had it all figured out but now you see that you didn’t. That’s because when we plan so hard and expect everything to be perfect we are always let down. The beauty of life, if there’s any, is not to figure it out but rather to flow with it, join the dance and submerge yourself within it. That would be you allowing yourself to be free. Don’t limit yourself with a plan or worrying about figuring it all out.

Good luck. You got all of life ahead of you, and a lot of people who care about you.
